new_results.statement: At the exact-null near-coloop endpoint Q=2r(sqrt(c)H+T)Y+aY^2+2bYW+dW^2, if t_i=gamma y_i+eta w_i on an ORIGINAL-coordinate set I with delta=det G_I>0, then ||p_Q||_inf <= 1/(2sqrt(c))+16 delta^(-1/2)c^(-1/4).
new_results.provenance: The regression residual is supported on I^c; conditioning those ORIGINAL variables leaves a two-dimensional product projection on I with density <=2/sqrt(delta). The resulting maximal slice quantity is fed into a reproduced single-hub square-fold bathtub argument.

new_results.statement: Under transverse row leverage <1/61, if the nonregressible longitudinal residual is supported on at most 30 leaves, then ||p_Q||_inf<32.12.

For the diffuse Fourier frame t_j=sqrt(2rho/m)cos(2theta_j), y_j=sqrt(2/m)cos(theta_j), w_j=sqrt(2/m)sin(theta_j), every exact regression-clean set has at most four rows and det G_I<=24/m^2, even though the full transverse Gram is I_2 and each row leverage is 2/m<1/61. Conditioning any subset does not remove this obstruction.
The pinned ruled-level-set theorem gives p_Q(s)<=pi sqrt(2) on the majority-sign side sign(d)s>=0; in the canonical harmonic family this is every s>=0.

first_unpaid_summary: Use aggregate ORIGINAL-coordinate transverse geometry after the partner conditioning contraction while retaining nonzero same-bank longitudinal contamination on every large reservoir, uniformly through the hub-Rayleigh null endpoint. Exact-regression extraction, worst conditional density, post-rotation independence, support/moments, and absolute-discriminant payment are not allowed.
